class.name: simple_gait
class.description: Fixed-gait sequencer (SimpleGaitSequencer): a gait from the gait database or a manual gait, with Raibert foot-step planning.

class.name: adaptive_gait
class.description: Velocity-adaptive gait sequencer (AdaptiveGaitSequencer): adapts period, duty factor and phase offsets to the commanded velocity.

class.name: bio_gait
class.description: Bio-inspired gait sequencer (BioGaitSequencer): picks a gait from the bio-inspired gait database by Froude number and blends between gaits over a transition, with Raibert foot-step planning. Research-grade gait quality; takes no gait parameters of its own.
